rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a BB blastocyst and correctly notes loose ICM/TE and thinned zona, but it overreaches from a single image with speculative features (e.g., borderline AB/AA, no degeneration/collapse) and discusses stage-label inconsistency without resolving morphology precisely.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian response, endometrium, male factor, lifestyle, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though some claims about male factor effects on euploidy/miscarriage are somewhat overstated for this dataset.

Reasoning is generally logical and structured, with prognosis tied to favorable maternal factors and moderate embryo quality; minor issues include mixed statements about 3BB being above average/not high prognosis and some speculative male-factor implications.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: transfer-worthy day-5 BB embryo, SET at age 34, avoid unproven add-ons, cautious stance on PGT-A. Small deviations include somewhat imprecise Gardner stage discussion and stronger-than-necessary emphasis on elective ICSI/sperm DNA fragmentation absent repeated failure.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support review, reviewing fertilization/blastulation data, and when to consider further sperm testing; useful though not highly tailored to specific protocol details.
